method.policy: Cross-check multiple independent source classes; do not back-project later beylik borders into 1326.

anchors.evidence: Pervâneoğulları ended in 1322 when Candaroğlu Süleyman Bey incorporated Sinop; Candaroğlu independence is later than 1326 and must not be projected backward.

Pervâneoğulları ended in 1322; later Taceddinoğulları are a 14th-century later formation and cannot be assigned to 1326. No sufficiently precise 1326 political boundary located in the reviewed sources.
Pervâneoğulları had previously controlled Bafra, but the polity ended in 1322. Later Canik divisions cannot be projected backward.
Later Taceddinoğlu control of the Çarşamba area is documented, but Taceddinoğulları emergence is after 1326.
Sources attest Çepni activity and later Haciemiroğlu control, but Emecen cautions against projecting the later dynasty backward to Kuşdoğan or early-14th-century activity.

anchors.assessment: Trebizond city/fortress with intense Turkmen frontier pressure
anchors.evidence: TDV records 1297 Turkmen/Çepni activity, early-14th-century attacks, and 1301 fortification by Alexios II after defeating Kuşdoğan.

chronologyGuards: Do not assign Taceddinoğulları as a sovereign polity in 1326; emergence is associated with the 1340s.
Do not assign Haciemiroğulları a precise 1326 polygon solely from later Ordu control.
Do not extend Candaroğlu Sinop control automatically west/east across all Canik in 1326.
Do not convert Çepni settlement or raiding activity into automatic territorial sovereignty.
Do not use 15th-17th century Canik administrative boundaries as 1326 geography.

runtimeModel.Ordu: frontierNode; Turkmen/Çepni activity; later Haciemiroğlu claim separated

sourceNotes: TDV Candaroğulları: Süleyman Bey expanded from Eflani to Kastamonu/Safranbolu and later Sinop; he continued recognizing Ilkhanid authority until later independence.
TDV Pervâneoğulları: Sinop polity ended in 1322 when Candaroğlu Süleyman Bey incorporated Sinop.
TDV Tâceddinoğulları: dynasty/polity belongs to the later 14th century, centered on Niksar-Kelkit; not a 1326 polity.
Emecen, XIV. Asır Doğu Karadeniz Tarihinden Bir Safha: Kuşdoğan was a Çepni leader active before the emergence of Haciemiroğulları/Taceddinoğulları; direct dynastic identification is uncertain.
TDV Çepni: Çepni groups were active around Sinop and Canik-Giresun, but this is ethnic/tribal activity evidence, not a ready-made political polygon.
Canik tahrir research: Ottoman incorporation of the region occurred much later, with Samsun around 1419-20 and Ordu/Çarşamba later; later administrative units are not evidence for 1326 boundaries.
